description: Area Management/ Restriction/ Regulation Zones and Reporting Units / Lärmschutzbereiche am Flughafen Berlin Brandenburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. Der interoperable INSPIRE-Datensatz gibt einen Überblick über die Lärmschutzbereiche am Flughafen Berlin Brandenburg (BER). Dies umfasst laut Gesetz zum Schutz gegen Fluglärm (FlugLärmG) die Tag-Schutzzonen 1 und 2 sowie eine Nacht-Schutzzone. Es erfolgte eine Schematransformation in das INSPIRE-Zielschema Bewirtschaftsungsgebiete/Schutzgebiete/geregelte Gebiete und Berichterstattungseinheiten. Coverage: Open Data Brandenburg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are bboxbebb, bewirtschaftungsgebieteschutzgebietegeregelte-gebiete-und-berichterstattungseinheiten, inspireidentifiziert, noise-restriction-zone, opendata. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
